# n2n-nexus

n2n-nexus is a local-first Model Context Protocol (MCP) coordination hub from N2NS Lab for multi-AI assistant collaboration. It uses a long-running local host, `n2n-nexus-host`, as the source of truth and lightweight MCP adapters from the `n2n-nexus` npm package for IDEs and AI coding assistants. Each Claude Code and Codex conversation has its own identity, taken from the client: `n2n-nexus install <claude|codex>` adds hooks that announce new direct messages to the recipient (on prompt, after tool calls, before the turn ends, or while listening), and the model reads them with a tool.

## Search intent coverage

- multi-agent MCP coordination
- multi-AI assistant collaboration
- local MCP coordination hub
- shared project context for AI coding agents
- cross-IDE MCP collaboration server
- local-first project registry for AI assistants
- meeting and task coordination for coding agents

## Core positioning

- Local MCP coordination hub for multi-AI assistant collaboration.
- Shared project context, meetings, messages, tasks, project manifests, docs, and assets.
- Designed for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, JetBrains, and other MCP-enabled clients.
- Useful when several AI assistants or IDEs need to coordinate around the same local project state.

## What it is not

- Not a project management SaaS.
- Not a vector database.
- Not a source code indexer.
- Not a cloud sync service.
- Not a replacement for repository-local memory tools such as n2n-memory.

## Install

Install the host, `n2n-nexus-host` (it runs as a tray app, or as a boot service with `n2n-nexus-host service install`):

```bash
brew install n2ns/tap/n2n-nexus-host                                   # macOS
scoop bucket add n2ns https://github.com/n2ns/scoop-bucket             # Windows
scoop install n2ns/n2n-nexus-host
```

Linux and all other platforms: archives on https://github.com/n2ns/n2n-nexus/releases (tags `host-v<version>`).

Install the client and connect Claude Code or Codex:

```bash
npm i -g n2n-nexus
n2n-nexus install claude    # or: n2n-nexus install codex
```

Configure other MCP clients with:

```json
{
  "command": "npx",
  "args": ["-y", "n2n-nexus", "mcp"],
  "env": {
    "NEXUS_ENDPOINT": "http://127.0.0.1:5688"
  }
}
```

## Storage

The host keeps all data in one SQLite database, `nexus.db`, in its data directory: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\n2n-nexus` on Windows, `~/Library/Application Support/n2n-nexus` on macOS, `~/.local/share/n2n-nexus` on Linux (`--root` or `NEXUS_ROOT` overrides it). Host settings are in `settings.json` in the same directory.

Built by N2NS Lab, Datafrog's open-source lab for practical AI developer tools.
